text.en: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power and magic in it.
text.ko: 할 수 있겠다 싶거나 꿈꿀 수 있는 일이라면, 시작하세요. 대담함에는 천재성과 힘과 마법이 들어 있다.
text.zh-cn: 只要你能想到、能梦到的事，就去做吧。大胆之中自有天赋、力量与魔力。

narration.en: Mist covered the hill at dawn. The hedgehog wanted to know what was up there, so it started climbing, one step at a time.
narration.zh-cn: 天刚亮，雾气盖住了山坡。刺猬想知道上面有什么，就一步一步往上爬。

narration.en: Halfway up, it slipped. Wet grass, one bad step, and it rolled all the way back down.

narration.fr: À mi-chemin, il a glissé. L'herbe mouillée, un faux pas, et il a dévalé la pente.
